0–15 共 16 个值，作用类似 PL 亚音：只有色码匹配的中继/台站才会解出: Values 0–15; it works like a PL tone: only stations/repeaters with the matching colour code decode your signal, separating networks on the same frequency.
BrandMeister、DMR-MARC 等网络，按时隙与通话组路由。: Networks such as BrandMeister and DMR-MARC, routed by time slot and talkgroup.
D-STAR 反射器/网关的模块字母（A / B / C）通常对应频段：A=23: The module letters of D-STAR reflectors and gateways (A / B / C) usually correspond to bands: A = 23 cm, B = 70 cm, C = 2 m.
DMR 每 30ms 一帧分成两个时隙（Slot 1 / Slot 2），两部电: A DMR frame lasts 30 ms and splits into two time slots, so two stations can talk simultaneously on one 12.5 kHz channel — time division stacked on the frequency channel.
DMR 需配置色码、时隙与通话组，匹配当地中继设置。: DMR needs a colour code, time slot and talkgroup matching the local repeater's settings.
WIRES-X 按房间号加入，支持跨洲语音与数据传输。: WIRES-X joins by room number and supports intercontinental voice and data.
WIRES-X 网络，支持房间与节点互联。: The WIRES-X network, which supports interconnection of rooms and nodes.
业余与商用最常用的中继/直频模式，TDMA 两时隙，可与 IP 骨干（Brand: The most common amateur/commercial mode: TDMA two-slot repeaters that can link to IP backbones such as BrandMeister.
免执照直频：446MHz 免许可频段设备，无中继、不联网（与独立标准 dPMR: Licence-free simplex on 446 MHz: no repeaters and no networking (not the same thing as the separate dPMR standard).
开源 DMR 网络，可与多协议桥接。: An open-source DMR network that can be bridged across several protocols.
每个时隙上再按「通话组 Talkgroup」或单呼地址路由：同一中继的两组用户可: Each slot routes by talkgroup or private-call address, so two user groups can chat independently through one repeater.
通过网关与反射器（Reflector）实现全球联网。: Worldwide linking through gateways and reflectors.
遵守当地中继的使用规范，避免长时间占用通话组。: Follow the local repeater's rules of use and avoid occupying a talkgroup for long periods.
集群调度系统，带控制信道的 trunking 架构，商用为主，业余较少用。: Trunked dispatch systems with a control channel; mainly commercial, rarely used by amateurs.
用呼号验证后把本地中继或单台接入互联网；节点分 -L（链路）、-R（中继）、-E: Verifies your callsign and links a local repeater or a single radio to the internet; nodes come as -L (link), -R (repeater) or -E (user).
基于 Linux 节点与控制板的联网方案，用 DTMF 指令连接远端节点；节点号: A Linux-node and controller-board linking system; you connect to a remote node with DTMF commands, and the node number is maintained by its owner.
基于 Asterisk 的开源语音联网，节点之间可互联，也常用于把模拟中继接进其: Open-source voice linking built on Asterisk; nodes can interconnect, and it is often used to bring an analog repeater into other networks.
联网语音进入本地中继后仍然占用本地频率：先听再做，别把网关当成自己的专用频道。: Linked audio still occupies the local frequency once it reaches the repeater: listen first, and do not treat the gateway as your private channel.
EchoLink 需要呼号验证；-L / -R 节点由持有者申请与维护，普通用户: EchoLink requires callsign validation; -L and -R nodes are applied for and maintained by their owners, while ordinary users connect via -E or straight to an -R.
IRLP 的 DTMF 指令与节点号由节点持有者设定，连接前先查当地节点的说明。: IRLP DTMF commands and node numbers are set by the node owner; check the local node's notes before connecting.
语音质量取决于两端网络，丢包时听起来像「断续」，不是你的电台出了故障。: Voice quality depends on both ends of the network; packet loss sounds choppy, which is not a fault in your radio.
跨境联网要留意当地规定：有些国家要求现场有本地控制操作员。: Cross-border linking has local rules: some countries require a locally licensed control operator on site.
